use default

class NODE(name: string, children: List[NODE])

leaf(name: string) -> NODE => NODE(name, LIST())

indented(node: NODE, depth: int) -> Pipe[string] is
    yield "{repeat(" ", depth * 4) |> join("")}{node.name}"

    for child in node.children do
        yield in indented(child, depth + 1)
    od
si

nested(node: NODE) -> string =>
    if node.children.count == 0 then
        node.name
    else
        "{node.name}({node.children |> map(nested) |> join(" ")})"
    fi

branches(node: NODE, prefix: string) -> Pipe[string] is
    for entry in node.children |> index() do
        let last = entry.index == node.children.count - 1
        let joint = if last then "\\- " else "+- " fi
        let carry = if last then "   " else "|  " fi

        yield "{prefix}{joint}{entry.value.name}"

        yield in branches(entry.value, "{prefix}{carry}")
    od
si

let tree =
    NODE("kingdom",
         [NODE("animal",
               [NODE("vertebrate", [leaf("bird"), leaf("mammal")]),
                NODE("invertebrate", [leaf("mollusc")])]),
          NODE("plant", [leaf("moss"), leaf("fern"), leaf("conifer")]),
          leaf("fungus")])

write_line("indented:")

indented(tree, 0) |> each(line => write_line("  {line}"))

write_line()
write_line("nested:")
write_line("  {nested(tree)}")

write_line()
write_line("drawn:")
write_line("  {tree.name}")

branches(tree, "") |> each(line => write_line("  {line}"))

    else
        "{node.name}({node.children |> map(nested) |> join(" ")})"
    fi

let tree =

         [NODE("animal",
               [NODE("vertebrate", [leaf("bird"), leaf("mammal")]),
                NODE("invertebrate", [leaf("mollusc")])]),
          NODE("plant", [leaf("moss"), leaf("fern"), leaf("conifer")]),
